senses.en: to combine two or more things into one

example.en: The two schools were amalgamated last year.
example.zh: 这两所学校于去年合并。

senses.en: to make weak; to weaken

example.en: Years of illness enfeebled the old man.
example.zh: 长年的疾病使老人变得衰弱。

senses.en: a small tack with a flat head used to pin papers to a board or wall

example.en: She pinned the notice to the board with a thumbtack.
example.zh: 她用图钉把通知钉在板上。

senses.en: to fasten something with thumbtacks

example.en: He thumbtacked the map to the wall.
example.zh: 他用图钉把地图钉在墙上。

collocations: thumbtack a note to the wall

senses.en: a person's first name, before the surname

example.en: Write your forename and surname on the form.
example.zh: 在表格上写上你的名和姓。

senses.en: a short general summary of a subject

example.en: The report begins with an overview of the company's performance.
example.zh: 报告以公司业绩概览开头。

senses.en: using or relating to invisible light with wavelengths longer than visible red light

example.en: The camera can take infrared photos at night.
example.zh: 这种相机能在夜间拍摄红外照片。

senses.en: electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than radio waves

example.en: Infrared is used in remote controls.
example.zh: 红外线被用于遥控器中。

senses.en: using cruel or insulting language

example.en: He was fired for making abusive comments to a coworker.
example.zh: 他因对同事出言辱骂而被解雇。

senses.en: treating someone cruelly or violently

example.en: She finally left her abusive husband.
example.zh: 她终于离开了虐待她的丈夫。

senses.en: to sell goods or services at a lower price than competitors
senses.zh: 以低于（竞争对手）的价格出售；削价竞争

example.en: Online stores can often undercut local shops on price.
example.zh: 网店的定价往往能低于本地实体店。

senses.en: to weaken or undermine something such as an argument or position

example.en: The new evidence undercut his argument.
example.zh: 新证据削弱了他的论点。

senses.en: (British) a tender cut of beef from the loin

example.en: The chef grilled a tender undercut steak.
example.zh: 厨师烤了一份鲜嫩的牛里脊排。

senses.en: a living example or embodiment of an idea or quality

example.en: She is regarded as the incarnation of kindness.
example.zh: 她被视为善良的化身。

senses.en: a particular form or version of something, especially as it changes over time

example.en: The company's latest incarnation focuses on mobile apps.
example.zh: 该公司最新的形态专注于移动应用。

senses.en: in Christianity, God becoming human in the person of Jesus Christ

example.en: The Incarnation is a central doctrine of Christianity.
example.zh: 道成肉身是基督教的核心教义。

senses.en: something used to lure animals or people into a trap

example.en: Hunters used a wooden duck as a decoy.
example.zh: 猎人用木鸭作诱饵。

senses.en: to lure or trick someone using a decoy

example.en: Thieves decoyed the guard away from the door.
example.zh: 窃贼把守卫诱骗离开了门口。

senses.en: to include something as part of a whole

example.en: The recipe incorporates fresh herbs and lemon.
example.zh: 这道食谱加入了新鲜香草和柠檬。

senses.en: to form a business into a legal corporation
senses.zh: 注册成立公司；使组成公司

example.en: The founders incorporated the business as a limited company.
example.zh: 创始人将这家企业注册为有限公司。

senses.en: a very strong feeling of fear

example.en: She froze in terror when the lights went out.
example.zh: 灯灭时她吓得呆住了。

senses.en: a person or thing that causes great fear

example.en: The dictator was a terror to his opponents.
example.zh: 那个独裁者令他的对手恐惧。

senses.en: the ability to focus your attention on one thing

example.en: Reading in a noisy room requires concentration.
example.zh: 在嘈杂的房间里读书需要专心。

senses.en: the amount of a substance in a solution or mixture

example.en: The concentration of salt in the water is low.
example.zh: 水中盐的浓度很低。

senses.en: a large number of people or things gathered in one place

example.en: The city has a high concentration of shops.
example.zh: 这座城市商店高度集中。

senses.en: the hot, bright part of a fire

example.en: The flame from the match lit the candle.
example.zh: 火柴的火焰点燃了蜡烛。

senses.en: to burn brightly or suddenly

example.en: The fire flamed up when the wind changed.
example.zh: 风向改变时，火苗猛地窜了起来。

senses.en: to become red or hot, especially from embarrassment or anger

example.en: Her cheeks flamed with embarrassment.
example.zh: 她尴尬得双颊发烫。

senses.en: a senior Christian clergy member who oversees priests or ministers and has spiritual and administrative authority
senses.zh: 主教；监督神父或牧师并拥有宗教和行政权威的高级基督教神职人员

example.en: The bishop visits the small parish each Sunday.
example.zh: 主教每个周日都拜访这个小教区。

senses.en: a chess piece that moves diagonally any number of squares

example.en: A bishop moves diagonally across the board.
example.zh: 象沿对角线在棋盘上移动。

senses.en: severe, strict, or unkind in criticism or treatment

example.en: The coach gave harsh criticism after the match.
example.zh: 比赛后，教练提出了严厉的批评。

senses.en: unpleasantly rough, bright, loud, or irritating to the senses

example.en: The harsh light made her close her eyes.
example.zh: 刺眼的光使她闭上了眼睛。

senses.en: difficult and unpleasant to live or work in

example.en: Many plants struggle in the harsh desert climate.
example.zh: 许多植物在严酷的沙漠气候中难以生长。

senses.en: something done, often to achieve a goal

example.en: Her quick action prevented a serious accident.
example.zh: 她的迅速行动避免了一场严重事故。

senses.en: the state of being active or the process of doing something

example.en: The machine is now in action.
example.zh: 这台机器现在正在运转。

senses.en: to take action on or implement, especially in business

example.en: Please action the request by Friday.
example.zh: 请在周五前处理该请求。

senses.en: to fire a gun or other weapon

example.en: The soldier was ordered not to shoot.
example.zh: 那名士兵奉命不得开枪。

senses.en: to take a photograph or film something

example.en: They plan to shoot the film outdoors.
example.zh: 他们计划在户外拍摄这部电影。

senses.en: to kick or throw a ball toward a goal

example.en: She shot the ball into the net.
example.zh: 她把球射入网中。

senses.en: a young branch or new growth on a plant

example.en: A new shoot grew from the cut stem.
example.zh: 一根新芽从剪过的茎上长了出来。

senses.en: the city where a country or region's government is based

example.en: Paris is the capital of France.
example.zh: 巴黎是法国的首都。

senses.en: money or property used to start or run a business

example.en: The company needs more capital to expand.
example.zh: 公司需要更多资金来扩张。

senses.en: a letter written in its large form

example.en: Write your name in capital letters.
example.zh: 请用大写字母写你的名字。

senses.en: one part or feature of a situation, idea, or problem

example.en: We discussed every aspect of the plan.
example.zh: 我们讨论了这个计划的各个方面。

senses.en: a typical feature or quality of a person or thing

example.en: Patience is a key characteristic of a good teacher.
example.zh: 耐心是一位优秀教师的重要特征。

senses.en: a quality that makes someone or something different from others

example.en: One distinguishing characteristic of this species is its long tail.
example.zh: 这个物种的一个显著区别特征是长尾巴。

senses.en: typical or distinctive of a person or thing

example.en: She spoke with characteristic calm.
example.zh: 她以一贯的镇定语气说话。

senses.en: a small roll of finely cut tobacco wrapped in paper for smoking

example.en: He put a cigarette in his pocket.
example.zh: 他把一支香烟放进了口袋。

senses.en: special importance or attention given to something

example.en: The school places strong emphasis on reading.
example.zh: 这所学校非常重视阅读。

senses.en: forcefulness or intensity in speaking or expression

example.en: He spoke with emphasis about the need for change.
example.zh: 他着重谈到变革的必要性。

senses.en: a device that explodes or burns brightly to produce colorful lights and sounds, used for entertainment

example.en: We watched the fireworks light up the night sky.
example.zh: 我们观看烟花照亮夜空。

senses.en: happening or paid once every year

example.en: The company holds a yearly meeting in June.
example.zh: 公司每年六月举行一次年会。

senses.en: once every year

example.en: They travel to the seaside yearly.
example.zh: 他们每年去一次海边。

senses.en: a book published once every year

example.en: The statistics are collected in the yearly.
example.zh: 这些数据收录在年刊中。

senses.en: suffering or death caused by lack of food

example.en: Millions of people faced starvation during the famine.
example.zh: 饥荒期间，数百万人面临饥饿的威胁。

senses.en: the act of depriving someone of food

example.en: The prisoners were kept alive but subjected to starvation.
example.zh: 囚犯们被留着一口气，却遭受饥饿的折磨。

senses.en: a common male given name

example.en: Daniel is my older brother.
example.zh: 丹尼尔是我的哥哥。

senses.en: in the Bible, a prophet known for his wisdom and for being protected in the lions' den

example.en: The Book of Daniel is part of the Old Testament.
example.zh: 《但以理书》是《旧约》的一部分。

senses.en: the activity of going to see people or places

example.en: Visiting friends and relatives is a big part of the holiday season.
example.zh: 探亲访友是假期的重要内容。

senses.en: the state of relying on someone or something else

example.en: He wants to reduce his dependence on his parents for money.
example.zh: 他想减少在经济上对父母的依赖。

senses.en: a physical or psychological need for a substance such as alcohol or drugs

example.en: Long-term use of the drug can lead to dependence.
example.zh: 长期使用这种药物可能导致依赖。

senses.en: progress or development in a job, science, or society

example.en: Recent advancements in medicine have saved many lives.
example.zh: 医学的最新进步拯救了许多生命。

senses.en: promotion to a higher position

example.en: She is seeking advancement within the company.
example.zh: 她正在公司内部谋求晋升。

senses.en: very polite, graceful, and elegant in manner

example.en: He greeted her with a courtly bow.
example.zh: 他彬彬有礼地向她鞠躬致意。

senses.en: to twist or bend out of its normal shape, or make something do this

example.en: Her face contorted with pain.
example.zh: 她的脸因疼痛而扭曲。

senses.en: to twist words or meanings unfairly

example.en: He contorted my words to make them sound like an insult.
example.zh: 他曲解了我的话，让它们听起来像侮辱。

senses.en: a performer who does skilled physical acts such as balancing and tumbling

example.en: The acrobat walked across a tightrope above the crowd.
example.zh: 杂技演员在人群上方的钢丝上行走。

senses.en: a comparison using 'like' or 'as' to describe something
senses.zh: 明喻（用 like 或 as 的比喻）

example.en: 'As brave as a lion' is a common simile.
example.zh: “像狮子一样勇敢”是一个常见的明喻。

senses.en: letting in cold currents of air

example.en: The old cottage was cold and draughty.
example.zh: 那座老房子又冷又透风。

senses.en: to defeat or trick someone by being more clever

example.en: The young chess player managed to outwit her experienced opponent.
example.zh: 这位年轻的棋手设法在智谋上胜过了经验丰富的对手。

senses.en: calm and unconcerned, appearing not to care
senses.zh: 漫不经心的；无动于衷的

example.en: He gave a nonchalant shrug and walked away.
example.zh: 他漫不经心地耸了耸肩，走开了。

senses.en: the deliberate damaging or destroying of property
senses.zh: 故意破坏他人财产（的行为）

example.en: The police are investigating the vandalism at the old station.
example.zh: 警方正在调查旧火车站遭到的故意破坏。

senses.en: consisting of various different kinds of things mixed together

example.en: The box contained miscellaneous tools and papers.
example.zh: 这个盒子里装着各种工具和文件。

senses.en: a beauty treatment for the hands and fingernails

example.en: She treated herself to a manicure before the wedding.
example.zh: 婚礼前她给自己做了一次修甲。

senses.en: to trim and shape someone's nails, or to trim something neatly

example.en: She manicured her nails carefully every week.
example.zh: 她每周都仔细修剪指甲。

senses.en: delicately small and pretty

example.en: She picked up the dainty teacup with two fingers.
example.zh: 她用两根手指拿起那只精致的茶杯。

senses.en: delicately delicious

example.en: The bakery sells dainty pastries.
example.zh: 这家面包店卖可口的精致糕点。

senses.en: the unhappy feeling you have when you know you have done something wrong
senses.zh: 因知道自己做错事而感到的内疚

example.en: She felt a deep sense of guilt after lying to her friend.
example.zh: 她对朋友撒谎后感到深深的内疚。

senses.en: responsibility for a crime or wrong act
senses.zh: 罪责；犯罪或过错的责任

example.en: The court had to establish his guilt.
example.zh: 法庭必须确定他的罪责。

senses.en: to make someone feel guilty

example.en: He tried to guilt her into staying.
example.zh: 他试图让她因内疚而留下。

senses.en: to feel bitter or angry about something, especially a wrong or unfair treatment

example.en: She resents being told what to do all the time.
example.zh: 她怨恨总是被人指手画脚。

senses.en: to draw out a response, answer, or reaction from someone

example.en: The question elicited a long silence from the audience.
example.zh: 这个问题引来了听众长久的沉默。

senses.en: all human beings; the human race

example.en: Vaccines have changed the health of mankind.
example.zh: 疫苗改变了人类的健康状况。

senses.en: the rate at which goods are produced or work is done, especially in relation to effort or time

example.en: The new software greatly improved the team's productivity.
example.zh: 新软件大大提高了团队的工作效率。

senses.en: the ability or power to produce things, such as crops or goods

example.en: Fertile soil has high agricultural productivity.
example.zh: 肥沃的土壤具有较高的农业生产力。

senses.en: a limitation or restriction on what is possible or allowed

example.en: Time was the biggest constraint on the project.
example.zh: 时间是该项目最大的限制。

senses.en: a state of being physically or socially restricted

example.en: He spoke with some constraint in front of his boss.
example.zh: 他在老板面前说话有些拘束。

senses.en: in a voice that can be heard; not silently

example.en: She read the letter aloud to her family.
example.zh: 她把信念给家人听。

senses.en: in a loud voice

example.en: Don't shout aloud in the library.
example.zh: 别在图书馆里大声喊叫。

senses.en: the edge at the top of a steep place such as a cliff

example.en: They stood on the brink of the cliff.
example.zh: 他们站在悬崖边上。

collocations: on the brink of the cliff

senses.en: the point where something very good or very bad is about to happen

example.en: The country was on the brink of war.
example.zh: 该国当时濒临战争。

senses.en: a large arrival of people, money, or things into a place

example.en: The city saw a large influx of tourists during the festival.
example.zh: 节日期间，这座城市涌入大量游客。

senses.en: a microorganism such as a bacterium or virus that causes disease

example.en: Doctors identified the pathogen causing the infection.
example.zh: 医生确定了引起感染的病原体。

senses.en: too attractive or tempting to refuse
senses.zh: 无法抗拒的，极具吸引力的

example.en: The smell of fresh bread was simply irresistible.
example.zh: 新鲜面包的香味简直令人无法抗拒。

senses.en: too small and confined; lacking space

example.en: The apartment felt cramped with so much furniture.
example.zh: 家具太多，公寓显得很局促。

senses.en: written or designed without enough space

example.en: The notes were in cramped handwriting.
example.zh: 笔记的字迹密密麻麻，难以辨认。

senses.en: stylish and fashionable

example.en: She wore a chic black dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿着一条时髦的黑裙子去参加聚会。

senses.en: stylishness and elegance in fashion or design

example.en: The hotel is famous for its simple elegance and chic.
example.zh: 这家酒店以其简约的优雅与别致而闻名。

senses.en: a vehicle that slides on runners over snow, pulled by animals or a person

example.en: The children took turns riding the sledge down the hill.
example.zh: 孩子们轮流坐雪橇从山坡上滑下来。

senses.en: to travel or ride on a sledge

example.en: They sledged down the slope after the heavy snowfall.
example.zh: 大雪过后他们乘雪橇从坡上滑下来。

senses.en: a heavy hammer with a long handle

example.en: He used a sledge to break up the concrete.
example.zh: 他用大锤砸碎混凝土。

senses.en: a gemstone with shifting colors, made of hydrated silica

example.en: She wore a ring with a beautiful opal.
example.zh: 她戴着一枚镶有漂亮欧泊的戒指。

senses.en: showing dry, ironic humor

example.en: She gave a wry smile when she heard the excuse.
example.zh: 听到这个借口时，她露出一丝苦笑。

senses.en: twisted or bent to one side

example.en: He made a wry face at the sour taste.
example.zh: 酸味让他做出了扭曲的表情。

senses.en: good for health; promoting good health

example.en: A healthful diet includes plenty of vegetables.
example.zh: 有益健康的饮食包括大量蔬菜。

senses.en: working closely together as a united whole

example.en: A cohesive team can overcome many challenges.
example.zh: 有凝聚力的团队能克服许多挑战。

senses.en: sticking or tending to stick together

example.en: Water forms beads because its molecules are cohesive.
example.zh: 水会形成水珠，因为水分子具有内聚力。

senses.en: made of many different kinds of things or people
senses.zh: 由不同成分组成的；多样的

example.en: The city has a heterogeneous population from many cultures.
example.zh: 这座城市的人口来自多种文化，构成多样。

senses.en: the miscellaneous equipment or items needed for a particular activity

example.en: Camping paraphernalia was piled by the door.
example.zh: 野营用品堆在门边。

senses.en: a short, sharp, high-pitched cry, especially from a dog

example.en: The puppy gave a yelp when it stepped on the thorn.
example.zh: 小狗踩到刺时发出了一声尖叫。

senses.en: to make a sharp, high-pitched cry

example.en: The dog yelped when someone accidentally stepped on its paw.
example.zh: 有人不小心踩到狗爪时，狗尖叫了一声。

senses.en: to make someone very annoyed or frustrated

example.en: The constant delays exasperated the passengers.
example.zh: 不断的延误让乘客们非常恼火。

senses.en: units of mass equal to one thousand grams

example.en: The suitcase weighs about twenty kilograms.
example.zh: 这个手提箱重约二十公斤。

senses.en: institutions of higher education that grant degrees

example.en: Many students apply to top universities every year.
example.zh: 每年有许多学生申请顶尖大学。
